title: Lightly Toasted American Potato Toast
description: A savory and crisp American dish featuring starch and toast, perfect for a snack or light meal. This dish is nut-free-friendly and showcases the simplicity of American cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the sliced potatoes with 1 tablespoon of butter, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder until they are evenly coated.
Arrange the potato slices in a single layer on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the potatoes in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until they are lightly toasted and crispy.
Meanwhile, toast the bread slices until they are lightly browned.
Spread the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter on each toasted bread slice.
Top each bread slice with a few slices of the toasted potatoes.
If using cheese, sprinkle it on top of the potatoes.
Serve the potato toast immediately and enjoy.
